summary.en: Three games played with nothing but your face — cheeks, tongue and lips are the controller.
summary.jp: 顔だけで遊ぶ 3 本のゲーム。ほっぺ・ベロ・口がそのままコントローラーになる。

mine: Designed three face-controlled games — KUZUSHI, KASANE and KAO DARUMA — each built around a different set of face muscles
Built a reusable face-expression engine that tells left, right and both cheeks apart in a 3D frame fixed to the face, and reads the tongue's direction
Ran the tongue-out output that MediaPipe's own face model computes but discards, in the browser with LiteRT.js
Built a reaction test bench that runs each game's own detection code, so every threshold was tuned against a real face

challenge.en: The movements that make a face game interesting are the ones face trackers read worst. MediaPipe gives a single, weak cheek-puff value with no left or right, and none of its 52 expression values is the tongue. Worse, simply tilting your head made one cheek look puffed. It all had to run on the phone already in your hand, with the camera image never leaving it.
challenge.jp: 顔で遊ぶゲームを面白くする動きほど、顔のトラッキングは苦手にしている。MediaPipe が出す頬の値は左右の区別がない弱い 1 つだけで、52 個ある表情の値にベロは入っていない。しかも、首をかしげるだけで片方の頬がふくらんだことになっていた。それを、手元のスマホだけで、カメラの映像を外に出さずにやる必要があった。

solution.en: Build the face-reading layer before the games. Cheeks are measured in a 3D coordinate frame fixed to the face — eye corner to eye corner, nose to forehead, and the direction the face points — so turning or tilting the head cancels out, and left, right and both are told apart. The tongue comes from an output MediaPipe's face model already computes and throws away. Every game reads the same engine, and nothing leaves the device.
solution.jp: ゲームより先に、顔を読む層を作った。頬は、顔に貼りついた 3D の座標（目尻から目尻、鼻の下から額、顔の正面の向き）で測る。首を振っても傾けても値は動かず、右・左・両方を見分けられる。ベロは、MediaPipe の顔モデルが計算していながら捨てていた出力から読む。どのゲームも同じエンジンを使い、処理はすべて端末の中で完結する。

cardLine.en: Puff a cheek, stick out your tongue — your face is the controller.
cardLine.jp: ほっぺを膨らませ、ベロを出す。顔がコントローラー。

oneLiner.en: Three browser games played with nothing but your face — cheeks, tongue and lips, read on the device.
oneLiner.jp: 顔だけで遊ぶ 3 本のブラウザゲーム。ほっぺ・ベロ・口の動きを、端末の中だけで読み取る。
